extra_groups.name: Behaviour values
extra_groups.description: How the car behaves while driving. This is how the effect of the greyed settings (springs, dampers, anti-roll bars, toe, the tyre model) is recorded.

rows.label: Speed
rows.description: Speed of the car in km/h.

rows.label: Engine rpm
rows.description: Engine speed.

rows.label: Gear
rows.description: The engaged gear (0 is neutral, -1 is reverse).

rows.label: Throttle
rows.description: Throttle pedal position from 0 to 1.

rows.label: Brake
rows.description: Brake pedal position from 0 to 1.

rows.label: Steering
rows.description: Steering angle, normalised from -1 to 1 and in degrees.

rows.label: G-forces
rows.description: Lateral, longitudinal and vertical acceleration in g.

rows.label: Rotation
rows.description: Angular velocity of the car and its pitch, roll and heading angle in degrees.

rows.label: Wheel load
rows.description: Load on each wheel in newtons.

rows.label: Slip
rows.description: Slip angle in degrees and slip ratio of each tyre.

rows.label: Suspension travel
rows.description: Travel of each suspension in metres.

rows.label: Tyre temperatures
rows.description: Core, inner, middle and outer temperature of each tyre.

rows.label: Brake temperatures
rows.description: Temperature of each brake disc.

extra_groups.name: Car state
extra_groups.description: Car-side values the game shows: tyre compounds, turbo and damper levels, in-car adjustments and their limits, brake wear. Useful to check that a tuner change arrived in the game.

rows.label: Tyre compounds
rows.description: The front and rear tyre compound in the game; shows whether the garage tyres arrived.

rows.label: Turbo
rows.description: The boost target of the car and the boost; shows whether a turbo kit works.

rows.label: Damper levels
rows.description: The in-car damper level (front and rear, bump and rebound) of cars that offer it.

rows.label: Engine brake and brake balance
rows.description: The in-car engine brake and brake balance adjustments.

rows.label: Engine map and performance mode
rows.description: The in-car engine map and performance mode, as index and name.

rows.label: Electronics limits
rows.description: The lowest and highest level of each in-car adjustment and which of them the car allows.

rows.label: Gears and fuel
rows.description: The number of gears and the size of the fuel tank.

rows.label: Mass and balance
rows.description: The height of the centre of gravity and the ballast.

rows.label: Brake wear
rows.description: Pad and disc life and the brake compounds.
